'''Derek Hawkesworth''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 63 from Lee on Solent, Hampshire, U.K., later London, U.K..<ref name="sm-fan" /> The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

"Age, 22. My hobbies include tennis, swimming, CCGs, snooker, guitar, travel, sci-fi and fantasy books. I've played Star Wars CCG since November of 1996, including six months in Madrid, where I learned to play properly. I hope to join the Rebel Squadron. Some of my favorite movie (series) are the Star Wars Trilogy, Star Trek, Alien, Ace Ventura and the Naked Gun."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/hawkesworth.html Derek Hawkesworth], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990427195913/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/hawkesworth.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
